answer: We usually deliver within 24-48 hours of confirming your order, depending on your location and order size.
Payment is made in cash on delivery using our mobile card/cash machine. No need to pay in advance.
We deliver across Windhoek and surrounding areas. Let us know your area and we'll confirm if we cover it.
There's no strict minimum for individual orders. For corporate/bulk orders, please place your order at least 2 days in advance.
All our produce is sourced fresh daily to ensure the best quality for you.
To cancel or change an order, just message us here directly and we'll sort it out for you.
The Bachelor/Spinster Box (3kg weekly, N$60) includes: 1kg Potatoes, 0.5kg Tomatoes, 0.5kg Onions, 0.5kg Carrots, 0.5kg Cabbage.
The Household Box (12kg weekly, N$240, feeds a family of 5) includes: 3kg Potatoes, 2kg Tomatoes, 2kg Onions, 1.5kg Carrots, 1.5kg Cabbage, 2kg Butternut & Sweet Potato.
